title: Slipway source map
description: /sourcemap.json at the site root: which source file, and which line in it, produced each built page, section, and link. Version 0 is a draft; see spec/sourcemap/v0.md. A url must not appear twice, which JSON Schema cannot express; tools/theme/sourcemap.ts checks it.

column.description: 1-based column in the source file, counting Unicode code points; a tab is one column.

line.description: 1-based line in the source file, front matter included.

source.description: The source file, relative to the site source folder, with forward slashes.

url.description: The page's URL path from the site root, as the generator writes it (`/docs/intro.html` or `/docs/intro/`).

column.description: 1-based column where the heading starts. Absent at the level-0 and level-1 maps of ADR 0007.

endColumn.description: Column of the heading's last character (inclusive). Absent when the map has no end (ADR 0026).

endLine.description: 1-based line where the heading ends; the same as `line` for a one-line heading. Absent when the map has no end (ADR 0026).

id.description: The heading's id in the built HTML.

column.description: 1-based column where the link starts. Absent at the level-0 and level-1 maps of ADR 0007.

endColumn.description: Column of the link's last character (inclusive). Absent when the map has no end (ADR 0026).

endLine.description: 1-based line where the link ends; the same as `line` for a one-line link. Absent when the map has no end (ADR 0026).

href.description: The link target as written in the source.
